gemini_description.purpose: Operating and maintenance instructions for a water pump system, detailing pre-operation checks, startup procedures, electrical specifications, and routine filter cleaning.
gemini_description.summary: This document provides step-by-step instructions for safely initiating and maintaining a water pump. It covers initial electrical checks, water-priming steps to avoid mechanical seal damage, motor rotation checks, startup procedures, and routine pre-filter strainer maintenance to prevent pressure drops.

components.name: Primary Filter / Pre-filter (المرشح الأولي)
components.description: Contains a strainer to catch large particles before they enter the pump. Must be filled with water prior to startup.

components.name: Strainer (المصفاة)
components.description: Removable component inside the pre-filter that blocks large debris. Requires cleaning every 100 operating hours.

components.name: Mechanical Seal (الحشية الميكانيكية)
components.description: Ensures leak-free operation; running the pump dry (without water) will damage this seal.

components.name: Motor Fan and Cover (المروحة وغطاء المروحة)
components.description: Located at the rear of the motor, used to visually verify correct rotational direction through an inspection slot.

components.name: Valves (الصمامات)
components.description: Flow control components that must be opened completely prior to starting the pump.

components.name: Electrical Cable (كابل الكهرباء)
components.description: Main power connection. Requires a sleeve of type H07 RN-F3 matching the motor's power and length.

procedure: Remove the primary filter cover by unscrewing its retaining nut.
Fill the pump with water through the pre-filter until water rises in the suction pipe.
If the strainer is removed during priming, reinstall it to prevent large debris from entering and clogging the pump.
Verify that the supply voltage and frequency match the pump's specifications plate.
Reinstall and tighten the primary filter cover, ensuring the seal (O-ring) is correctly positioned in its housing.
Verify correct motor rotation direction by looking at the fan through the inspection slot in the fan cover.
Open all valves and connect the motor power.
Activate self-priming and wait a reasonable duration until the cycle is completed.
Clean the primary filter strainer every 100 operating hours to avoid pressure drops, taking care not to strike it during cleaning.

technical_details.detail: Delta (Δ) connection is used for the lowest voltage, and Star (Y) connection for the highest voltage, except for 032/004V and 096/004V.
AC connection requires an H07 RN-F3 sleeve with a cable cross-section compatible with the motor's power and cable length.
The main power cable must only be connected by certified, skilled electricians.
Maintenance interval for cleaning the pre-filter strainer is every 100 operating hours.

warnings.warning: Do not operate the pump without first filling the primary filter with water. Operating dry will damage the mechanical seal due to loss of water.
When cleaning the strainer, do not tap or strike it, to prevent breaking the component.
